headline.text: L3 ML1 was down *7 hours overnight* on hopper gasket failure and glycol leak — back up by 02:57.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 1 started depositing S'mores with X-ray and metal detector sensitivity issues — both cleared by mid-shift. Sollich 2 saw recurring decorator tempering swings with multiple pauses through the night. Sollich 4 ran caramel cluster with no breaks; safety flag on metal scrapper found near guillotine.
per_plant_summary.L2: FFS ran batch changes cleanly through the shift. ML2 saw increasing mixer jams from rice powder buildup. ML3 started depositing after overnight clean; mold jam at first shaker cleared, welds broke but running. Panning sorter blocked on felt material piece that won't pass QA inspection — waiting on replacement.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 down from 21:04 to 02:57 on hopper gasket break and glycol leak — cleaned, reassembled, then hit mixer auger temp fault at shift start. ML4 ran with recurring mold jams at reject section through first shift — cleared by 09:02. Truffle line saw aligner skip rows causing accumulation; parameter adjustments at 05:11 brought it back.

notes.text: Vendor support extended on S1: Chocotech (Volker) through next Friday, Eaglestone (Russ) through next week, Sollich (Ricardo) through next week, Matrix (Alex) leaving Friday — replacement requested.
Truffle line changeover plan: stop dark chocolate addition at 12:30 on Friday 2nd shift, fill new melting tank with milk chocolate to be ready for Monday start.

resolved.title: S2 mini tempering unit chocolate return stopped
resolved.summary: Chocolate return on mini tempering unit stopped working, no chocolate feeding to depositor.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:16 — completed reheat on mini tempering unit and washed hoses, line back up and running (Katya Farnsworth).

resolved.title: S1 X-ray rejecting 60–70% of pouches
resolved.summary: X-ray over-rejecting after product learn; Troy re-learned product and ran test cards successfully with no false rejects in 100 pouches.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:29 — Troy re-learned product, test cards passed, no false rejections in close to 100 pouches.

resolved.title: S1 metal detector not reading yellow card
resolved.summary: Metal detector failed to read test card at start of 1st shift, blocking production start.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:39 — Jorel adjusted metal detector, all cards now passing (Mary Montilla).

resolved.title: S1 metal detector opening repeatedly on sensitivity
resolved.summary: Metal detector triggered 5 times in short span; no metal found in product during inspection, appeared to be sensitivity issue.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 10:32 — Jorel adjusted sensitivity, Jorge reaching out to Heat and Control for support; no openings in last 30 minutes (Jorel Gourdin).

resolved.title: S2 tunnel 3 belt slipping
resolved.summary: Tunnel 3 belt slipping; heavy buildup in catch pan for drive roller required cleaning.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:15 — completed CIL on rollers and cleaned catch pan buildup, line back running (Katya Farnsworth).

resolved.title: ML3 mold jam at first shaker
resolved.summary: Mold jam at first shaker required maintenance to clear.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:02 — jam cleared, molds entering smoothly despite broken guide welds (Gustavo Rodas).

resolved.title: ML2 mold jam
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 08:28 for mold jam.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:32 — jam cleared, line running (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: ML1 C6 belt tear with metal found
resolved.summary: Metal object found on C6 belt at 14:52; belt had a tear that required patching.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:47 — maintenance patched C6 belt tear, QA ATP passed, rails and conveyors adjusted to prevent contact with belt, line running (Imperial).

resolved.title: ML1 hopper gasket failure and glycol leak
resolved.summary: At 21:04 a piece of the plate gasket broke off and got stuck in the block, causing chocolate to come out badly on molds. At 03:49 a glycol leak occurred from a valve onto two molds and inside the hopper. Line required full drain, hopper/nozzle cleaning, and reassembly.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 02:57 — hopper reassembled, glycol connection fixed (blue tube seated properly), line back up and running. Hose replaced on mixer auger glycol connection due to wear marks (Nelson Cook 10:41).

resolved.title: Truffle line aligner skipping rows causing accumulation
resolved.summary: Aligner skipping over rows of chocolate causing heavy accumulation; 15-minute gap taken at 02:11 to pass through bins.
resolved.resolution: Running good at 06:25 — parameter adjustments made: manual workstation aligner 45→28, input belt 4.0→4.15, output belt 8.5→10.0; 0 bins accumulated (Jose Vasquez 05:11, TruffleLine FW 06:25).

resolved.title: ML4 mold jams at reject section
resolved.summary: Recurring mold jams at the mold reject area in the mold exchange section through first shift; maintenance tightened loose reject plate and adjusted height on both sides.
resolved.resolution: Running good at 09:02 after reject plate height adjustment on both sides and multiple jam clears (Rich Brierley).

resolved.title: Truffle line electrical cabinet trip
resolved.summary: Something tripped inside electrical cabinet above the line, preventing start.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 18:03 — reset breaker in electrical cabinet, getting everything in temper to start depositing (Tyson Fausett).

resolved.title: ML1 mixer auger temperature fault with hard chocolate
resolved.summary: At shift start, mixer auger showed temperature faults and chocolate was hard even at 120°F setpoint, likely due to overnight fault causing chocolate to harden.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:41 — mixer auger removed, cleaned, reassembled; maintenance replaced hose due to wear marks and verified valve/connections (Nelson Cook).

needs_attention.title: S2 decorator tempering swings high
needs_attention.summary: Decorator mini temper unit running high (1.1–1.5) through 2nd and 3rd shifts, requiring multiple line pauses and adjustments; target changed to 0.5 due to freezing pipe issues.
needs_attention.status: Line paused at 08:36 for high temper (1.2), restarted at 08:54; recurring issue through night with multiple temperature and chocolate cycling interventions.

needs_attention.title: Metal scrapper found near S4 guillotine
needs_attention.summary: Nathan found a metal scrapper by the guillotine and instructed team that no metal scrappers are allowed in that area.
needs_attention.status: Team instructed at 08:42; follow-up needed with William and Luis on preventing recurrence.

needs_attention.title: SafetyChain scrap form showing multiple products
needs_attention.summary: Scrap form in SafetyChain displaying multiple products when trying to enter scrap for only one ingredient.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 22:37 to Dakota Adair and Jorel Gourdin; no resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: ML2 mixer jams increasing from rice powder buildup
needs_attention.summary: Filler operators have cleaned the mixer twice on 3rd shift due to rice powder buildup; may need to move to cleaning the mixer every shift.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 02:16; recommendation to increase cleaning frequency to every shift.

needs_attention.title: Sorter felt material piece won't pass inspection
needs_attention.summary: Quality states the sorter will not pass inspection until a felt material piece is replaced because it cannot be cleaned sufficiently.
needs_attention.status: Dave Ruff reached out for quote on all consumables at 09:16; Jorel suggested cleaning without soaking; replacement pending.

needs_attention.title: ML4 unfilled bars reached packaging
needs_attention.summary: Bars with only chocolate (no filling) found in packaging area at 09:57; 2 pallets placed on hold for inspection and rework.
needs_attention.status: Hold and rework in progress as of 10:13; Preston requested photo eye rejection systems be enabled and investigation into how bars bypassed rejection; linked to mold jam issues causing poor scrape-off.

needs_attention.title: ML1 C7 and infeed belts have tears
needs_attention.summary: In addition to the C6 belt tear, C7 belt and infeed belt also have tears that need replacement.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 15:44; Dave Ruff confirmed 4 spare C6 belts available; belts need replacement but line running as of window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 1 riser pump pressure dropped
needs_attention.summary: Depositor 1 riser pump pressure dropped to 5.1 on 3rd shift.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 06:29; no follow-up or resolution posted in window.

needs_attention.title: ML3 shaker guide welds broke
needs_attention.summary: When clearing a mold jam at the first shaker, the welds on the guide rails broke; molds entering smoothly for now.
needs_attention.status: Dave Ruff assessed at 05:26: can repair when line is down; monitoring for now.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix waiting for box labels
needs_attention.summary: Finishing setup for SRS product but waiting for box labels to arrive.
needs_attention.status: Still waiting for labels as of 08:17 (Rich Brierley).

needs_attention.title: Truffle line M4 belt alarm
needs_attention.summary: M4 belt alarm going off even though the belt is moving; maintenance called.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 07:55; no resolution posted by window close.
